name: file-tree
title: File Tree
description: A nested list of files and folders from a flat list of paths. A folder is a button that folds what is under it; a file is a router link (`linkSlot`) or a button (`onSelect`), filled when it is `selected`. `meta` puts a size or a badge after a name, `actionSlot` puts rename and delete beside the row rather than inside it, `pinned` keeps a file above the tree, and `onMove` lets a row be dragged onto a folder in a browser.
